name: Project Brain v1 and Platform Intelligence Registry
summary: Adds a runtime Project Brain service and a visible subsystem version registry, while strengthening Decision Engine rules, Event Engine contracts and platform diagnostics.
changes: Added Project Brain runtime service with machine-readable roadmap, architecture, backlog, decisions, principles, capabilities and release history.
Added subsystem version overview to Mission Control.
Added generic rule evaluation and version metadata to Decision Engine results.
Added once and waitFor contracts to Event Engine.
Added module and Project Brain consistency diagnostics.
Fixed duplicate Platform Doctor startup declaration.
